GRAPH_COMPLETION.sql_skeleton:
WITH Sales_GMV AS (
    SELECT
        'Myntra' AS marketplace_name,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sales_gmv
    FROM
        zs_observe.myntra_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true
    GROUP BY 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'LimeRoad' AS marketplace_name,
        SUM(gmv_amount) AS total_sales_gmv
    FROM
        zs_observe.limeroad_settlement
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true
    GROUP BY 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        sales_channel AS marketplace_name,
        SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales_gmv
    FROM
        zs_observe.increff_sales
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES'
    GROUP BY 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'Amazon' AS marketplace_name,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sales_gmv
    FROM
        zs_observe.amazon_oms
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true
    GROUP BY 1
),
Myntra_Recon_Complexity AS (
    SELECT
        'Myntra' AS marketplace_name,
        SUM(variance_amount) AS myntra_recon_variance_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS myntra_unreconciled_orders_count
    FROM
        zs_observe.myntra_oms_settlement
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22' AND (recon_status != 'MATCHED' OR variance_amount != 0)
    GROUP BY 1
),
Myntra_Non_Order_Adjustments AS (
    SELECT
        'Myntra' AS marketplace_name,
        SUM(non_order_settlement_amount) AS myntra_non_order_adjustments_amount
    FROM
        zs_observe.myntra_non_order_settlement
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true
    GROUP BY 1
),
Myntra_Pending_Receivables AS (
    SELECT
        'Myntra' AS marketplace_name,
        SUM(pending_amount) AS myntra_total_pending_receivables
    FROM
        zs_ingest.myntra_receivables
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22'
    GROUP BY 1
),
Myntra_MP_Fees AS (
    SELECT
        'Myntra' AS marketplace_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(prepaid_mp_fees, 0) + COALESCE(postpaid_mp_fees, 0)) AS myntra_mp_fees
    FROM
        zs_observe.myntra_settlement
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true
    GROUP BY 1
),
Increff_Return_Complexity AS (
    SELECT
        sales_channel AS marketplace_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT return_id) AS increff_total_returns,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN qc_status IS NOT NULL THEN return_id END) AS increff_returns_with_qc,
        COUNT(DISTINCT return_reason) AS increff_distinct_return_reasons
    FROM
        zs_observe.increff_returns
    WHERE
        group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true AND return_status = 'COMPLETED'
    GROUP BY 1
),
All_Marketplaces AS (
    SELECT marketplace_name FROM Sales_GMV
    UNION
    SELECT marketplace_name FROM Myntra_Recon_Complexity
    UNION
    SELECT marketplace_name FROM Myntra_Non_Order_Adjustments
    UNION
    SELECT marketplace_name FROM Myntra_Pending_Receivables
    UNION
    SELECT marketplace_name FROM Myntra_MP_Fees
    UNION
    SELECT marketplace_name FROM Increff_Return_Complexity
)
SELECT
    am.marketplace_name,
    COALESCE(sg.total_sales_gmv, 0) AS total_sales_gmv,
    COALESCE(mrc.myntra_recon_variance_amount, 0) AS myntra_recon_variance_amount,
    COALESCE(mrc.myntra_unreconciled_orders_count, 0) AS myntra_unreconciled_orders_count,
    COALESCE(mnoa.myntra_non_order_adjustments_amount, 0) AS myntra_non_order_adjustments_amount,
    COALESCE(mpr.myntra_total_pending_receivables, 0) AS myntra_total_pending_receivables,
    COALESCE(mmf.myntra_mp_fees, 0) AS myntra_mp_fees,
    COALESCE(irc.increff_total_returns, 0) AS increff_total_returns,
    COALESCE(irc.increff_returns_with_qc, 0) AS increff_returns_with_qc,
    COALESCE(irc.increff_distinct_return_reasons, 0) AS increff_distinct_return_reasons
FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT marketplace_name FROM All_Marketplaces) am
LEFT JOIN
    Sales_GMV sg ON am.marketplace_name = sg.marketplace_name
LEFT JOIN
    Myntra_Recon_Complexity mrc ON am.marketplace_name = mrc.marketplace_name
LEFT JOIN
    Myntra_Non_Order_Adjustments mnoa ON am.marketplace_name = mnoa.marketplace_name
LEFT JOIN
    Myntra_Pending_Receivables mpr ON am.marketplace_name = mpr.marketplace_name
LEFT JOIN
    Myntra_MP_Fees mmf ON am.marketplace_name = mmf.marketplace_name
LEFT JOIN
    Increff_Return_Complexity irc ON am.marketplace_name = irc.marketplace_name
ORDER BY am.marketplace_name;
